test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following airports is located in Amritsar?

options.text: Sri Guru Ram Das Ji International Airport

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Guru Ram Das Ji International Airport.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An **international airport **serving** Amritsar, Punjab, India** is Sri Guru Ram Das Ji International Airport.
 
• It bears **Guru Ram Das' name,** who was the fourth **Sikh Guru** and the city of **Amritsar's founder.**
 
• The airport is** Punjab's biggest and busiest airport.**
 
• After Indira Gandhi International Airport in Delhi, it is the **second-largest airport** in Northern India.
 
• In India, the airport experienced the** third-fastest growth during the 2017–18 fiscal year.**
 
• It serves as a hub for both **domestic and foreign cargo** transfers.
 
• In** 2019 and 2020, Skytrax r**ecognized the airport as the** sixth-best regional airport **in India and Central Asia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thiruvananthapuram International Airport:**

 
 
• An** international airport t**hat serves Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala, India, is known as Thiruvananthapuram International Airport.
 
• It was established in **1932**.
 
• It is India's** fifth international airport** and the first in the state of Kerala.
 
 
 
• **Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar International Airport:**
 
 
• An international airport serving **Nagpur, Maharashtra, **India is Dr Babasaheb Ambedkar International Airport.
 
• It was given the** B. R. Ambedkar name in 2005.**
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi International Airport:**
 
 
• The** main international airport serving Delhi **is Indira Gandhi International Airport.
 
• According to statistics published by the **UK-based group, OAG**, it is the seventh** busiest airport** in the world as of** 2022. **
